summary.nativeRuntime: Not exercised by these browser suites; native Apple SDK build and iOS Simulator checks are reported separately by the build workflow.

environment.input: Shipping keyboard and DOM touch handlers; no game state mutation
environment.clock: Playwright clock drives normal requestAnimationFrame and fixed 120 Hz simulation
environment.viewport: 874 × 402, DPR 2, touch/mobile browser context, simulated safe insets 62/62/21
limitations: Not physical iPhone hardware or native WKWebView.
Does not measure hardware touch latency, battery usage, or device frame rate.
Browser validation used Playwright WebKit 26.5 for Linux with software graphics, not physical iPhone hardware.
The touch checks dispatch PointerEvents through the shipping handlers; they do not measure physical touch latency or iOS gesture recognition.
A controlled browser clock drives normal requestAnimationFrame and fixed 120 Hz gameplay. Route elapsed time and screenshot sequence frame rates are not device performance measurements.
The save-migration suite seeds an authentic prior-version localStorage shape to exercise the update path; installation persistence on physical hardware is a separate check.
Native signing, installation and WKWebView startup are outside this browser report and must be read from the native build workflow.

Visual capture is separate from the clean runtime checks. Playwright screenshot preparation can inject an empty inline stylesheet that the shipping CSP rejects; that tooling-only warning is not counted as a game runtime error. No application CSP exception was added.

visualEvidence.method: Actual shipping renderer and UI at 874 × 402 CSS pixels, DPR 2, with simulated landscape safe insets 62/62/21.
visualEvidence.directory: QA capture filenames; selected frames are also copied into the repository preview directory by the release owner.
